window_selection: 32 integer-linspace input ends from 34560 through 46076 inclusive; zero-based end-exclusive; no targets read
order: rotate engine order by trial+seed_index+workload_index; each cell in a fresh serial process
timing: monotonic ns; all 96 outputs; inputs resident/prepared; no clock subtraction; one sample per synchronous forward; read checksum outside timing
statistics: nearest-rank p50/p95/p99, mean, min/max; per-trial reports and ranges, no IID confidence claim
memory: process peak RSS after imports, setup and timing; high-water marks, not live allocation or attributable model memory; native owned bytes separately
limitations: Warm resident inputs; uncontrolled OS scheduling/frequency/cache
Torch standard uses FP32 layer_norm, GELU and causal SDPA; strict reference uses FP64 reductions
CPU compatibility benchmark on available host, not current-runtime frontier
No compiled Torch, ONNX, quantization, profiling, sustained/concurrent streams or network costs
First call follows model loading; no cold-disk/cache or full process startup claim
